text: This staff report is a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. This report identifies and corrects a conflicting parking by-law on the north side of Pears Avenue, east of Avenue Road by introducing a "house-keeping" by-law amendment.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the maximum one-hour parking limit in effect, from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., on the north side of Pears Avenue, between Avenue Road and a point 310.9 metres east, to be in effect from 10:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.
